main.description: Lists indexed location records; authentication is not required. Array filters use repeated unbracketed query keys; filters combine with AND, values within each array with OR, and omitted filters are unrestricted.

uris.description: Filter by full location AT-URI with a DID authority; matching uses the URI, not a CID.

locationTypes.description: Match exact strings against locationType; empty strings are matched literally.

cursor.description: Opaque keyset cursor; keep all other parameters unchanged between pages. The cursor is bound to sortDirection, and pagination is not snapshot-isolated.

sortDirection.description: Sort by a valid zoned createdAt; otherwise indexedAt or stored row creation time, then URI, all in this direction. Defaults to desc.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: A query parameter is invalid, unknown, or repeated where only one value is allowed.

locations.description: Matching location records in page order.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page; omitted when there is no next page.
